tool_args.rationale: The initial five rows had inadequate s_grad variation, but the acquired discriminating probe supplied substantial leverage at s_grad 0.18 and 2.35. The observations remain monotone-concave in u_now and are consistent with the shared siphon base plus a signed square-root branch. Fit vmax, rho, and local branch coefficient numerically across all paid rows, using the specified wide fallback bounds.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid open-branch probe added broad s_grad leverage (0.18 and 2.35), resolving the narrow-span confounding; additional trajectory data is not presently needed to fit the 3-parameter smooth branch.
Observed responses increase monotonically with u_now over the tested range, matching the monotone-concave pilot signature rather than a high-u decline.
The square-root branch is the open completion slot supported by the monotone-concave signature; no evidence favors mass-drift leak.
